text: Halt! Stand where you are. Lower your weapon, and come no closer to the trees.
instruction: Use the reference speaker's voice. Speak as an elven warden giving a firm command to an intruder: clear, strong and authoritative, projected but controlled. Short, decisive phrases with crisp consonants and a hard, falling, final pitch on each command. Steady and certain; not shouting, not growling, not angry, not rushed. A guard of the forest who expects to be obeyed. Natural spoken dialogue.
status: owner accepted 2026-10-24 as a guide for curt refusals (final avon_2)
